'''Choclime twists''' were a tangy-sweet dessert item enjoyed by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. They came in stick form, in resealable [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] packages.
